brief:
The Knesset prepared to vote on three legislative proposals challenging Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu, the Shehab Wire reported. The bills concern establishing an inquiry committee into October 7 failures, imposing restrictions on serving as prime minister, and the ultra-Orthodox military draft crisis.

The votes represent a new political and legal test for Netanyahu as coalition formation negotiations stall. The legislative push comes amid mounting pressure over governance and accountability issues.

title: Knesset votes on three bills threatening Netanyahu's political future
